title: SCIF meeting with AARO head Jon Kosloski
summary: James Fox tells of SCIF meeting with AARO head Jon Kosloski, about 2020s at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he's like, "You know, James, I can't part my hair without the approval of the DoD."

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox, who made a film called The Phenomenon, says that in the 2020s he met Jon Kosloski, head of AARO, the Pentagon office that now investigates UFO reports, inside a SCIF, a sealed room near the Pentagon used for classified conversations. Fox says Kosloski told him, "You know, James, I can't part my hair without the approval of the DoD," meaning the Department of Defense. Fox tells it as a sign of how little freedom the office's head had to speak.
